title: Add continuity API functions to React client
description:
Modify react_ui/src/api/client.ts to add TypeScript fetch functions for continuity endpoints: timeline queries, ritual management, and narrative callbacks.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- react_ui/src/api/client.ts (existing API client — understand base URL configuration, fetch wrapper patterns, TypeScript conventions, and existing types/functions)
- chatbot/continuity/timeline.py (created by task c.1)
- chatbot/continuity/rituals.py (created by task c.3)
- chatbot/continuity/narrative.py (created by task c.2)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY react_ui/src/api/client.ts. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed path. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed file modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

Implementation details:

1. Open react_ui/src/api/client.ts and inspect the existing API function patterns: base URL configuration, fetch wrapper, TypeScript type conventions, error handling. All new code must follow these conventions.

2. Add TypeScript interfaces:
   - `TimelineEntry`: entry_id (string), session_id (string), entry_type ('milestone' | 'emotional_event' | 'promise' | 'running_project'), title (string), description (string), content (string), turn_id (string), created_at (string), updated_at (string), status ('active' | 'resolved' | 'broken' | 'completed' | 'abandoned'), tags (string[]), metadata (Record<string, unknown>).
   - `TimelineFilter`: session_id (string | null), entry_types (string[] | null), statuses (string[] | null), tags (string[] | null), date_from (string | null), date_to (string | null).
   - `RitualInfo`: ritual_id (string), session_id (string), name (string), ritual_type ('check_in' | 'recap' | 'planning' | 'recurring' | 'joke' | 'custom'), description (string), schedule_description (string), last_triggered_at (string | null), next_trigger_at (string | null), is_active (boolean), trigger_prompt (string | null), created_at (string), metadata (Record<string, unknown>).
   - `NarrativeThread`: thread_id (string), session_id (string), label (string), turns (string[]), created_at (string), last_referenced_at (string), relevance_score (number), summary (string).
   - `ThreadCallback`: thread_id (string), label (string), callback_text (string), turn_id (string), confidence (number), thread_summary (string).
   - `CreateRitualRequest`: name (string), ritual_type (string), description (string), schedule_description (string), trigger_prompt (string | null).

3. Add async fetch functions following the existing pattern:
   - `fetchTimeline(sessionId: string, filter?: TimelineFilter): Promise<TimelineEntry[]>` — GET /timeline/{sessionId} with optional filter query params.
   - `fetchActiveProjects(sessionId: string): Promise<TimelineEntry[]>` — GET /timeline/{sessionId}/projects/active.
   - `fetchPendingPromises(sessionId: string): Promise<TimelineEntry[]>` — GET /timeline/{sessionId}/promises/pending.
   - `resolveTimelineEntry(entryId: string, resolution?: string): Promise<TimelineEntry>` — POST /timeline/{entryId}/resolve.
   - `fetchNarrativeThreads(sessionId: string): Promise<NarrativeThread[]>` — GET /narrative/{sessionId}/threads.
   - `fetchThreadCallbacks(sessionId: string, message: string): Promise<ThreadCallback[]>` — POST /narrative/{sessionId}/callbacks with {message} body.
   - `fetchRituals(sessionId: string, type?: string): Promise<RitualInfo[]>` — GET /rituals/{sessionId}.
   - `createRitual(sessionId: string, request: CreateRitualRequest): Promise<RitualInfo>` — POST /rituals/{sessionId}.
   - `deactivateRitual(ritualId: string): Promise<void>` — DELETE /rituals/{ritualId}.

4. Existing API functions in client.ts must not be removed or changed.
acceptance_criteria: react_ui/src/api/client.ts exports TimelineEntry, TimelineFilter, RitualInfo, NarrativeThread, ThreadCallback, CreateRitualRequest types
react_ui/src/api/client.ts exports all nine continuity fetch functions
All new functions use the existing fetch wrapper or URL pattern from client.ts
Existing API functions in client.ts are not removed or changed
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: remove or rename existing exported functions from client.ts
introduce a new HTTP client library
change the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends

allowed: add TypeScript interfaces matching the Python dataclass shapes
add async fetch wrapper functions following existing client.ts patterns
use the existing base URL and error handling conventions
forbidden: introduce axios, react-query, or any new HTTP/data-fetching library
change the fetch wrapper pattern or base URL configuration
